mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals an overheating labor market that triggers inflation concerns and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both rise >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns as economic expansion supports corporate profitability and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 QoQ growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts Fed rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent month-over-month increases in industrial production and housing starts indicate broad economic expansion, boosting corporate output and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO and HOUST both rise >0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained month-over-month growth in non-farm payrolls supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where the Fed funds rate is below 2.5% and inflation exceeds 2.0%, the market expects continued monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%.
